text:
emily.g: quick idea dump — i'm tired of ad-hoc heuristics flipping between fp8/int8/4bit mid-request. thinking of a tiny 'bitwidth switch matrix' evaluated once per request with a lock window. want feedback.

raj.k: what inputs to the matrix? just latency signals or quality ones too?

emily.g: both. start minimal: degradation_score (0-1), token_zone (head/mid/tail), kv_cache_miss_rate, model_capabilities, and customer_override. output: allowed_bitpaths (ordered) + reason_tag.

taylor: need an example to grok it.

emily.g: example matrix rows: 

```
row id: low_tail_cached
when degradation_score <= 0.025 and token_zone == tail and kv_cache_miss_rate < 0.05
allow: [fp8, int8]
reason: "low-risk tail with stable cache"
lock_window: 64  # tokens
```

```
row id: moderate_any
when degradation_score <= 0.06 and model_capabilities contains fp8
allow: [fp8]
lock_window: 32
```

row id: safe_default
allow: [fp32]
```

morgan: nice. add an estimated_risk_score per-row so we can sort candidates and surface a confidence band.

ops-bot: telemetry reminder — keep cardinality low. use short hashed ids for rows, and sample full contexts ~0.5%.

hana-bot: telemetry proposal: attach bw.row=sha1(row_id) bw.inputs=(ds,zone,kv) bw.allowed and bw.risk_bucket. include trace when sampled.

raj.k: runtime compatibility question: some fused kernels don't support fp8 or 4bit. how do we handle that?

emily.g: runtime must query model_adapter.supported_paths(model_id) first. decision = intersection(matrix_allow, supported_paths). if empty => fallback_kind = "higher_fidelity_variant" or route_to_nonquant_path. tag reason.

taylor: and oscillation? last time we flipped on punctuation which produced artifacts.

emily.g: lock_window prevents token-by-token swapping. also require change only at sentence boundary or when confidence_delta across window < threshold. plus single-change-per-request limit.

morgan: rollout plan?

emily.g: shadow mode: run matrix for 14 days @ 3-5% traffic, compute paired quality deltas per-cohort (intent cohorts, customer cohorts). measure exact-match, nll delta, and hallucination proxies.

raj.k: define auto-disable triggers.

emily.g: propose: if cohort exact-match drop > 0.4% absolute OR hallucination proxy up > 0.25% absolute -> pause matrix for that cohort and alert. also circuit-break if latency_p99 for quant path +10% for 5m.

ops-bot: add: daily rollup metrics: decisions.count, choices.fp8_pct, choices.4bit_pct, avg_degradation_by_choice, latency_p95_by_choice, rollback.count. keep metric names short.

hana-bot: include kv_cache_miss_rate in decision telemetry; high miss correlates strongly with quality loss.

taylor: API ergonomics: GET /v1/bitpath?inputs=... should return {row_hash, allowed_paths, risk_score, lock_window, explain_tag}. helpful for debugging and local replay.

emily.g: config precedence: customer_pin > route_flag > matrix_default. control-plane stores final allowed_paths for runtime.

raj.k: sampling for repro: store prompt_hash, deterministic_seed, kv_prefix_hash, model_version when sampled. privacy redaction step before saving.

morgan: ops wants one pager for oncall: how to toggle matrix per-cohort, sampling toggles, and thresholds. i'll draft.

emily.g: i'll write a short RFC with: 1) matrix grammar, 2) runtime contract + adapter query, 3) telemetry keys + sampling plan, 4) rollout + shadowing, 5) ops playbook with circuit-breakers.

ops-bot: note — please limit full-context captures to 0.5% to avoid storage spike.

taylor: i'll own the rollout runbook and alerts. raj, can you produce a capability matrix per-model by EOD?

raj.k: yes, i'll list which fused ops support which bitpaths and expected failure modes.

emily.g: thanks all. will ping when RFC is up for review. tagging @taylor @morgan. :sparkles:
